title: Comic Project, Page, Panel & Layer Schema
objective: Define stable comic project, page, panel and layer contracts with ARI resource references, presentation-only transform state, text elements and output metadata, without embedding source assets by default or taking authority from Character, Scene, ARI, rights/provenance or later SAA composition tranches.
acceptance: Project, page, panel and layer identities are explicit, stable and versioned with deterministic ordering/serialization.
Layers reference ARI-governed resources by identity/provenance reference rather than embedding source asset bytes by default.
Schema defines presentation-only transform state sufficient for later composition behavior without implementing the SAA-03 canvas.
Text elements remain actual typed text state with stable identity rather than raster-only presentation.
Output metadata is typed and deterministic without granting export/share/publication authority.
Character, Scene, map and other source-domain truth remain references; SAA-01 creates no replacement canonical owner state.
Rights/capability references are preserved for later operation filtering; SAA-01 does not invent a parallel rights ledger.
Round-trip serialization preserves project/page/panel/layer identity, ordering, references, transforms, text and metadata.
Provider-off local operation is supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-02+ behavior, public sharing, marketplace, external tester distribution and final Creator integration remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-01 defines schema only; panel layout grammar belongs to SAA-02 and interactive layer composition behavior belongs to SAA-03.
ARI remains resource identity/provenance/rights authority; SAA references ARI resources instead of duplicating them by default.
Character/CAPP/PAPT and MAI/Scene remain canonical appearance/spatial owners; SAA stores presentation references only.
Transform fields are presentation state and do not mutate source assets or canonical Scene/Character truth.
Third-party transform/export/share operations require later independent rights-capability enforcement.
AI remains proposal-only and is not required for SAA-01.
No SAA successor or SMB10B implementation authority is granted by selection.
next_action: The owner's current instruction authorizes governed start of SAA-01 immediately after this S02 closeout/selection becomes canonical.
